column1: # Allow-listed identity collisions (plan section 5.2 step 3, D106; curated in the repo).
# Each row is a group of different recipes, in one map, whose identity hashes start with the
# same 12 hex digits: they share a citation key r:<map>/<sig12>. A group listed here with its
# exact size is accepted as genuine, and its recipes get the keys r:<map>/<sig12>-1, -2, ...
# in content-hash order; a group that isn't (or has another size) fails `gos db build`, which
# writes a curation task with ready-made rows to GOS_HOME/data/curation/collisions-<run>.tsv.
# Check each new group in NEI before adding it, and say why it is genuine.
# The rows below came from the dev-runtime harness run of 2026-11-06 (GT 5.09.54.265 and its
# dependencies); the first full-pack run will show which still apply (stale ones are reported).
